map.风暴潮增水由气压减水与风应力增水叠加：气压减水 hP=ΔP×100/(ρg)（Δ: The storm surge is the superposition of the pressure-induced setup and the wind-stress setup: pressure setup hP=ΔP×100/(ρg) (ΔP = standard pressure − central pressure), wind-stress setup hW=C·V²/g × direction factor (V is the maximum wind speed); total surge = hP+hW, and combined with typhoon intensity grading (by central pressure) it gives blue/yellow/orange/red warning levels for coastal flood-control scheduling.
map.💡 总增水 = 气压增水 + 风增水；气压增水 Δh_p = (P₀-Pc)/(: 💡 Total surge = pressure surge + wind surge; pressure surge Δh_p = (P₀-Pc)/(ρ·g) (inverse barometer effect); wind surge Δh_w = C·Vmax²/g × direction factor.
map.气压增水采用反气压计效应：海面因低气压抬升，每降低1hPa约增水1cm: The pressure surge uses the inverse barometer effect: the sea surface rises due to low pressure, about 1 cm per 1 hPa drop
map.风增水采用经验公式 C≈0.003，实际值受水深、海岸形状和风区影响显著: The wind surge uses the empirical formula C≈0.003; actual values are strongly affected by water depth, coastal shape and fetch
map.移动方向系数：向岸(1.0)、斜向岸(0.6)、沿岸(0.4)、离岸(0.15): Direction factors: onshore (1.0), diagonally onshore (0.6), alongshore (0.4), offshore (0.15)
map.本工具为简化估算模型，实际风暴潮需结合数值模式预报: This tool is a simplified estimation model; actual storm surges require numerical model forecasts
map.由最大风速估风增水高度辅警风暴潮。: Estimate the wind surge height from the maximum wind speed to assist storm surge warning.

map.最大风速 vmax=30 m/s、重力加速度 G=9.8、方向系数 1 → 风增: Max wind speed vmax=30 m/s, gravitational acceleration G=9.8, direction factor 1 → wind surge Δh=0.003×30²/9.8×1≈0.275 m=27.5 cm; if the superimposed astronomical spring tide exceeds the warning level, issue a warning.
map.增水+天文潮超警戒 0.5m 蓝色、1m 黄色、2m 橙色、3m 红色，本例 2: Surge + astronomical tide exceeding the warning level: 0.5m blue, 1m yellow, 2m orange, 3m red; in this example 27.5 cm alone triggers no warning, but combined with a spring tide it must be re-checked.
map.风增水只是风暴潮一部分？: Is the wind surge only part of a storm surge?
map.是。总增水=风增水+气压增水（每降 1hPa 约 +1cm）+天文潮，三者叠加才: Yes. Total surge = wind surge + pressure surge (about +1 cm per 1 hPa drop) + astronomical tide; only the superposition of the three determines the final water level.
map.蓝色预警就撤离吗？: Does a blue warning mean evacuate?
map.不。蓝色为最低级提示，红色（增水≥3m）才启动大规模撤离，以本地预案为准。: No. Blue is the lowest-level notice; only red (surge ≥3m) triggers large-scale evacuation, subject to local plans.
